evidence_quotes.O: I have a mess of old Sinatra records that I've always wanted to listen to and maybe transfer to my computer and now I finally can!
evidence_quotes.C: Had to format it in NTFS, which took almost 2 hours, but it worked. I can copy over large files (4+ gigs) with no problem.
evidence_quotes.E: Wanna plug that baby into your laptop? This is what you need! It works. What more can you say? There's not much to it.
evidence_quotes.A: I never liked the idea of a subwoofer shaking my place and possibly upsetting the neighbors.
evidence_quotes.N: I cannot adequately explain how utterly maddening this is. Go to hit seek while driving, fingers slip and change the source!
